title: ADDENDA: A SUPPLEMENTAL HISTORY
text:
ADDENDA: A SUPPLEMENTAL HISTORY        17

The following program has been approved by the Board of Managers for 1942:

SIXTH REUNION
OF
SAVOY COLLEGE EX-STUDENT ASSOCIATION
Savoy, Texas
Sunday, June 28, 1942

MORNING

 9:30  Song, "America," by audience.....................J. B. May
                                               Reunion Song Leader
       Piano Accompanist ..............................William P. Boyd
       Invocation ........................................Elder John Taylor
       Scripture...... Reader, Rev. Will Pritchett, Bells, Texas
       Song, "College Reunion Song".....................J. B. May
             Words by Martha Buford May
             Tune, Battle Hymn of the Republic
             Piano accompanist, William P. Boyd

10:00  School Days During the Late
          Seventies.........By Bill Jones, '76-'78, Paris, Texas
       Early Eighties...................By Newt Ridings, '80-'82,
                                                    Bonham, Texas
       "Barber Shop Melodies," Mystery Quartette,
          led by .........................................................................
       Late Eighties .......................By Tom Smith, '88-'89,
                                                   Sherman, Texas
       After the Eighties...............By Bill Gardner, '90-'95,
                                                Durant, Oklahoma
       Professor Halsell as known by Indian students
          .....................James Culberson, Durant, Oklahoma
       Song, "Old Black Joe"........The Lee Hampton Singers
             Piano accompanist, Mrs. Lew Reynolds,
                          Arlington, Texas
notes: Page 17 of appendix. Printed program for the Sixth Reunion, June 28, 1942.
